episodes.title: Um desastre como o Brasil nunca viu
episodes.summary: While searching for scraps, two men discover a lead capsule containing a glowing blue powder — but their quest for profit soon takes a sinister turn.

episodes.title: Quando a gente vai voltar pra casa?
episodes.summary: As the news spreads, families are divided and panic grows in Goiânia. Meanwhile, Orenstein and his team discover danger lurking around every corner.

episodes.title: A gente tá bebendo água contaminada?
episodes.summary: The crisis deepens as rumors spread about radiation in the city's water. Some riot against the doctors' methods, while others appeal to their compassion.

episodes.title: A gente sempre tem uma opção
episodes.summary: The crisis draws global attention and aid, but the path to a solution is rocky. Márcio gains firsthand insight into the lives of the isolated patients.

episodes.title: Alguém precisa confiar em alguém
episodes.summary: One month into the crisis, tragedy unfolds, dividing the community's sympathies. Can a series of bold actions bring the nightmare closer to an end?
